messages:
rachel: Post-launch quick sync  thinking we should run a 2-sprint 'stabilize + small wins' runway. Proposal: sprint allocation 65% bugs / 35% enhancements but with a strict fast-path for customer-impacting fixes and tiny QOLs. URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/postlaunch-playbook

tyler: Agree on runway. Can we define 'tiny QOL'? I vote for <=2 dev-hours + automated tests + feature flag. Also want an exceptions flow for high-paying customers.

nina: +1. Ops constraints: canaries required for any prod change, and we only have one daily hotfix window during the sprint: 18:30-19:00 UTC. I'll reserve.

pieter: From infra: P0s (service down / data loss) go straight to triage and hotfix. P1 (severe degradation) get prioritized, but not auto-hotfix unless customer SLA at stake.

rachel: Fast-path rules summarized: (1) P0 blocking -> immediate triage; (2) tiny QOL (<=2h, tests, flag) -> fast-lane if PM approves; (3) customer-requested non-blocking change -> fast-lane if CS signs off and deploy behind flag.

tyler: Acceptance criteria to close sprint-green: no new customer-visible regressions, top-10 flow error rate < 1.5% for 48h post-release, p95 latency within 25% of baseline.

nina: I'll add canary thresholds and dashboards. Also will mute noisy alerts during canary channel for the duration.
pieter: Release cadence: fix -> internal canary (1h) -> extended canary (24h) -> global. For tiny QOLs we can accelerate: fix -> 30m canary -> global if no regression. Need release window tomorrow 2026-03-28 18:30 UTC. @release-bot can you reserve?

release-bot: reserved: canary-2187654320 slot on 2026-03-28T18:30:00Z. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/postlaunch-canary.

rachel: Owners: tyler -> infra fixes, nina -> rollout/ops, pieter -> observability & thresholds, rachel -> PM/comms. GH label: postlaunch-stabilize-2187. Jira board updated.

tyler: I'll open the top 8 bug PRs and tag owners. For tiny QOLs I'll require a 1-sentence dev note in the PR describing risk and rollback plan.

nina: Ops will create a hotfix calendar entry and a short canary checklist: smoke tests, customer traffic sample, error budget check.
pieter: Note: quantify rollback cost per change; some tiny QOLs touch infra config and would be higher risk. PMs please mark those out.

rachel: Good call. Add a 'risk' field on tickets: low/medium/high. Fast-path only allowed for low risk.

tyler: Communication: I'll prepare a short status note for CS to send to affected customers after canary green. Templates: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/customer-templates.

nina: Weekly sync cadence: Mon 09:00 PT. Ad-hoc P0 huddle when needed.
pieter: Decision summary: two-sprint stabilize + small wins, 65/35 allocation, fast-path rules as above, canary + daily hotfix window reserved. Reassess at end of sprint 2.

rachel: Locking plan unless objections by EOD. :thumbsup:

tyler: :thumbsup:
